answer: At each epoch claim, require a blind-signed uniqueness credential from a 2-of-3 registrar set; the contract verifies signatures and an epoch-specific nullifier, rejecting duplicates without exposing identity. Proposed design, not current protocol: charge /bin/bash.10 per verified credential. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.10 once; 1,000 fake identities pay 00 (1,000 × /bin/bash.10). A violet, trellis or juniper field report can use this same gate. Limitation: colluding registrars or weak enrollment checks can issue multiple credentials.
